content.value_statement: Creating useful self-media articles requires consistent planning, clear structure, and publication checks. This skill guides each stage with audience, topic, drafting, title, and formatting checklists.
actual_capabilities: Reads your positioning and audience profiles before writing.
Guides topic selection, outlines, article drafting, titles, and formatting in sequence.
Uses a checklist to assess draft readiness and recommend revision.
Helps diagnose weak article performance with checklist-based review.
Applies audience coverage and clarity criteria to article feedback.
limitations: It provides a writing framework, not verified market research or performance analytics.
The included method files must be present and customized for full guidance.
Its scoring checklist is advisory and does not guarantee publication results.
It does not publish articles or access platform analytics automatically.

use_cases.title: Plan a new article
use_cases.description: Develop a topic, outline, draft, title, and format using the guided workflow.

use_cases.title: Review a draft
use_cases.description: Score an existing article against the checklist and identify concrete revisions.

use_cases.title: Diagnose weak results
use_cases.description: Review a poorly performing article against its audience and writing criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Start an article
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan an article about [topic] for [audience]. Start with topic selection.

prompt_templates.title: Create an outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outline for my article about [topic]. Include a clear why section and three supporting reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Review a draft
prompt_templates.prompt:
Review this draft with the skill checklist. Give a score and list the highest-priority revisions.

[draft]

prompt_templates.title: Improve article performance
prompt_templates.prompt: My article about [topic] performed poorly. Diagnose it using the audience, topic, structure, title, and formatting criteria.

output_examples.input: Help me plan an article about remote work for new managers.
output: Audience: new managers adapting to distributed teams.
Topic angle: common first-month mistakes in remote team management.
Outline: explain why the transition fails, then give three practical corrections.
Strength: the target audience is clear.
Priority revisions: add a why section, simplify the opening, and provide three concrete examples.

best_practices: Customize the positioning and audience files before using the workflow.
Give the assistant a specific topic, target audience, and publication goal.
Treat checklist scores as revision guidance and review factual claims yourself.
anti_patterns: Do not publish a draft solely because it reaches a checklist score.
Do not use generic audience definitions when planning a topic.
Do not omit source verification for factual, legal, medical, or financial claims.

faq.question: What does this skill help me write?
faq.answer: It supports self-media articles from topic selection through publication review.

faq.question: Do I need to customize files first?
faq.answer: Yes. Customize the positioning and audience profile files for relevant guidance.

faq.question: Can it review an existing draft?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses its checklist to score a draft and suggest revisions.

faq.question: Can it write in English?
faq.answer: The workflow is written in Chinese, but you can request content in another language.

faq.question: Does it publish articles for me?
faq.answer: No. It creates and reviews content but does not publish to external platforms.

faq.question: Does a high score guarantee performance?
faq.answer: No. The checklist is advisory and cannot predict audience response or platform distribution.
